data.title: Safa Two
data.about:
Welcome to Safa Two by Damac. This elite high-end residential destination offers you a collection of branded apartments. Every home is crafted to perfection by the Swiss brand de Grisogono. 

If you want to live an opulent life, Safa One has everything you need. Embrace the best of nature, and the best of a lifestyle you cannot compare with any other.

characteristics_module.title: Unparalleled High-End Lifestyle
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Luxury trophy assets
  • Prices starting at AED 750K
  • Ideal prime location on Sheikh Zayed Road
  • Pay 75% during constructio
  • Pay 25% on completion
  • World’s highest Fog Forest
  • Podium level artificial beach pool
  • Stunning studios, 1 – 3 bedroom apartments

location_tile.title: Located in the heart of Dubai
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description: Located ideally on the main arterial road of Dubai, that is Sheikh Zayed Road, Safa Two is easily accessible. Just minutes away from the main attractions of the city, Safa Two is located perfectly. Safa Two is a crowning jewel in Dubai and is nestled close to Safa Park. It is easily accessible for the residents. When you live in Safa Two, you are just minutes away from Burj Al Arab, Palm Jumeirah, Bulgari island as well as the World islands.
